attempts.prompt:
Korean webtoon panel, digitally inked and coloured by a professional webtoon studio. Crisp black ink with tapered strokes, heavier on the outer silhouette, the jaw, the hair mass and where forms overlap. Flat local colour with one hard-edged cool cel shadow per material. One named key light: its colour washes smoothly over the lit side. If the scene names a back light, it draws a thin crisp rim along the figure's silhouette. Everything else stays flat. Muted cool base palette of slate, navy and grey-blue, so the light source and the character's signature colour carry the saturation. Background simplified and lower in contrast than the characters. Small crisp highlights; glossy specular only on metal and wet surfaces.
Hand-made webtoon colouring: each garment has only a few large, opaque, clean-edged shadow shapes, placed in its real folds; no scattered translucent streaks, zigzag shards or crumpled-foil folds. Worn cloth shows a few small frayed notches and loose threads, never sawtooth edges along every edge. Plain shoes and clothes with no logos, stripes or brand marks. Every strap, buckle, pocket and seam is attached and has a purpose; no stray stitch marks. Matte skin, hair and stone; no 3D, low-poly or plastic look.
Use case: illustration-story. Asset: L22 cold_store_gate/slit.png. Full-detail location reference, exact native 1536x1024 landscape PNG. Recipe: establish, eye-level view 1.6 m above the floor from just inside an open industrial cold-store doorway looking along the central aisle. One coherent room perspective. Named key light: the visible cold white fluorescent ceiling tube; secondary local light from the gate's very pale white-cyan rim and violet interior. Keep the upper ceiling quiet and shadowed, with no interface, no window or symbols.
The room is the walk-in freezer at the BACK of the covered Busan harbour fish market: 8 m deep, with a 2.5 m central aisle between two rows of 2.3 m-high dark-grey steel storage racks, both sets firmly on the concrete floor. Racks hold ordinary open white frozen-fish boxes with a few plain blue crates, recognizable whole silver mackerel packed inside, blank box faces. White frost on metal edges, boxes, panelled insulated walls, and a small portion of the door jamb cropped at the extreme left. A rectangular evaporator unit with TWO round fans is high on the far wall; a drain pipe attaches below and follows the back wall. Floor frosted but clearly a solid planar concrete surface, not floodwater. All fixtures functional and attached, modest icicles only.
In the MIDDLE of the clear aisle, between the left and right racks, hangs a single narrow door-height vertical GATE slit, about 2.1 m high and 0.6 m at its widest. It is a torn crack in space, not a built doorway: a nearly black-violet core #1A1026 with violet depth, enclosed by a THIN jagged cold white-cyan rim #D8F4FF. Violet light locally spills over the closest box corners and ice; a little violet ash curls from the slit, with no full-frame fog or haze. Its lower point is just above the floor, whose frost reflects the thin rim; no pedestal and no cyan floor circle. The slit stays visibly shorter than the rack height and large enough for one adult, with the large stoneback character later needing to duck. No monsters, no figures or named cast. Every shelf, fish box and fish remains physically ordinary; only the gate is supernatural. No text anywhere.
Reference 1: the APPROVED freezer-lane key is for industrial frost, refrigeration materials, lighting and hand-inked V2 style only, not its trucks or alley layout. Reference 2: the APPROVED acting anchor is for line and opaque cel colouring only, not its cast, costumes, weapons or composition. Build the new cold-room geometry exactly from the text.
No text, letters, numbers, speech bubbles, captions, sound-effect lettering, interface windows or readable signs. Emblems without letters are fine; no brand logos or wordmarks. Not a 3D render, not a photograph, no photographic background. No airbrushed skin, no plastic gloss on skin or hair, no haze or bloom over the whole image, no depth-of-field blur, no lens flare unless a real camera flash is in the scene. No watermark or signature. Correct hands with five fingers. No chibi proportions unless the brief says chibi. No compressed or stubby bodies, no shortened legs or torsos, no oversized heads; no people out of scale with the doors, vehicles and buildings around them; no figures floating off the floor or breaking the scene's perspective.

images.checks: Door-height narrow violet gate with black-violet core and pale jagged rim, locally reflected on frost; racks/boxed frozen fish and two-fan far-wall evaporator; no people, lettering, UI or CALL circle.

The finite rectangular hall is 25 m ACROSS and approximately 28 m deep, its vaulted roof rising about 11 m, a compact temple hall rather than a vast cathedral.
